name: harness-vet
description: Adoption gate for external agent tooling. Vet a skill, plugin, MCP server, rules file, repo, or paper before adding it to your harness: install-state and overlap checked against what you already run, claims verified by running them, context cost priced, per-component ADOPT/ADAPT/EXTRACT/SKIP/REJECT verdicts with re-eval triggers — and an audit dividend that often outvalues the verdict.
